notes: Reached only through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in my own tab, https://www.nkuku.com/. robots.txt was read from the page context: it contains no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot line at all, only the standard Shopify admin/checkout/search exclusions. No 403, challenge or rate-limit was seen at any point. TREE = union of three sources per brief 7b.1: (a) the desktop mega-menu (.mega-menu__link--parent columns) for the Garden, Furniture and Sofas menus, (b) the collection sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 780 handles) keyword-scanned for furniture slugs, (c) the /pages/furniture landing-page tile strip plus each room-rollup page's own link block (source c added nothing new). Sitemap-only gains over the nav that are emitted: Wardrobes (4) and Drinks Tables (0). QTY METHOD (Rule 1): every qty is the site's own rendered listing header 'N items', taken from the server-rendered HTML of each collection URL fetched same-origin from the loaded page. Cross-checked against the live DOM on /collections/armchairs (body innerText '31 items' == SSR '31 items'). For every leaf I confirmed HTTP 200 and that the page h1 and rel=canonical are the node I asked for (trap 2) - no slug silently served a parent listing. Counts vary per category (desks 3, armchairs 31, all-furniture 154), so no site-wide constant is being echoed. The Shopify /collections.json products_count field was deliberately NOT used: the prior Home-Decor pass on this store proved it inflated (mugs raw 93 vs verified 44). OVERLAPS - Shopify collections here are not a partition. Corner Sofas is a subset of Made to Order Sofas; Bistro Tables & Chairs is a subset of Garden Tables & Chairs; Bedroom Benches (8/8) and Storage Benches (6/8) also sit inside Benches. Each of those rows carries a flag. Verified disjoint by product-handle set comparison and therefore left unflagged: Made to Order Armchairs (14) shares 0 handles with Armchairs (31), and Ready to Deliver Sofas (5) shares 0 handles with Made to Order Sofas (56). EXCLUDED - View All / rollup nodes (rules 2 and 3): all-furniture 154, seating 130, all-tables 66, all-storage 61, all-garden-furniture 35, bedroom-furniture, all-outdoor, all-living, all-kitchen-dining, home-office-all 64, hallway-bootroom 80, bedroom-storage 25, kitchen-furniture 21 (genuine furniture, but a room rollup of dining tables / counter chairs / cabinets already captured as leaves), coffee-side-tables 24 (superseded by the separate nav leaves Coffee Tables 17 and Side Tables 30, and not their union), outdoor-tables 11 and outdoor-seating 19 (sitemap-only alternates that overlap the four nav garden leaves), all-storage-furniture 0 and relaxed-garden-seating 0 (retired, empty, sitemap-only). EXCLUDED - storage-shelving 'Cabinets & Shelving Units' (39) is a mixed rollup: it contains all 13 Free-Standing Shelves, 15 of the 37 Cabinets & Sideboards, and 13 unique items that are storage benches and WALL shelves (indore-wall-shelf, tamba-wall-hung-shelf, mahi-wall-shelf-with-towel-rail, olani-bathroom-shelf). Wall shelves are Wall Decor's job, so the specific children were kept instead of the rollup. EXCLUDED - not furniture, decided on product handles rather than on the label: wine-racks-cabinets 'Wine Racks, Shelves & Holders' (4) is shray-iron-wine-rack, shanthi-reclaimed-wood-wine-rack and two obra-industrial-wine-racks - standalone storage goods, not cabinets; bathroom-furniture (2) is mahi-wall-shelf-with-towel-rail plus mahi-wall-mounted-toilet-roll-holder - bathroom hardware, with no vanity or cabinet in it, so despite the name it is not a Bathroom Furniture row; fabric-swatches (samples/parts); pet-beds-cushions. EXCLUDED - section 3 junk: new-furniture, sale-furniture, full-priced-furniture, furniture-lighting-sale, the material-filter collections (wooden-furniture, metal-furniture, leather-furniture, reclaimed-wooden-furniture, ira-travertine-mango-wood-furniture) and roughly 180 per-SKU family collections (deni-*, guddu-*, *-furniture-collection, aamani-furniture, nirvi-furniture and similar). Nkuku is a stock-gated Shopify storefront, so these headers are in-stock snapshots (trap 4); Desks (3), Wardrobes (4) and Beds & Headboards (8) are genuinely small ranges for this brand rather than misreads.
